question: Which bounded native-renderer object and device fields have proved byte coverage for buffer, declaration, texture, surface, binding, dirty, command, and lifetime paths?

boundedQuestions: VB and IB headers, declaration allocation and copied records
texture and surface descriptor fields, including parent-backed and standalone constructors
device stream, sampler, texture, shader, render-target, declaration and dirty-state bindings
draw command cursor and commit header fields, plus resource refcount and fence readers
scope.boundary: Static foreground read-only evidence only. The layouts are partial where a consumer, producer, or allocation extent was outside the bounded sets.

dependencies.use: Accepted device dirty words, register shadows, bindings, and static-state boundaries.
Accepted 0x34-byte texture header and qualified descriptor-word roles.
Accepted ring-span emitter and command-state comparison boundary.
Accepted indexed draw sink and caller-side submission edge.
Accepted shader-loader consumers of device shader bindings.

currentEvidence.method: Three bounded foreground read-only DumpFunctions runs, a bounded instruction window whose saved listing was sparse, and exact generated-code corroboration for the same identified functions.

querySets.result: status OK; canonical truncation left generated corroboration necessary

objectLayouts.name: vertex_buffer
objectLayouts.claim: 0x20-byte vertex-buffer header with encoded control, address-tag, and fetch-size words.

fields.name: header_control_word
qualifications: The writer selects encoded control values, but no bounded reader or complete bit meaning is proved.

fields.name: initialization_word
qualifications: The creator initializes the same +0x04 counter used by common AddRef/Release paths; identity across resource variants is qualified and lifetime side effects make it visible.

fields.name: control_sentinel
qualifications: The observed value is 0xFFFF0000; no masking rule is supported.

fields.name: data_address_tagged
qualifications: The constructor stores an allocation-derived address OR 3 and the stream setter reads the word; host pointer meaning remains unresolved.

fields.name: fetch_size_word
qualifications: The constructor preserves a control bit, masks the size portion, and adds the encoded base; the setter consumes it as a fetch/size input.

unresolvedRanges: +0x08..+0x13 remains unresolved in this bounded header read.
qualifications: The two creation paths prove selected writes only; they do not prove a complete C++ layout.

objectLayouts.name: index_buffer
objectLayouts.claim: 0x20-byte index-buffer header with encoded type, address, and size/control words.

fields.name: header_control_word
qualifications: The draw sink reads this word from the bound index buffer; exact format subfields remain unresolved.

fields.name: initialization_word
qualifications: The observed value is 1; no bounded reader or lifetime meaning is proved.

fields.name: control_sentinel
qualifications: The observed value is 0xFFFF0000; no masking rule is supported.

fields.name: data_address
qualifications: The draw sink consumes the bound index-buffer address word.

fields.name: size_or_control_word
qualifications: A separate reader is outside this bounded set; retain the word as visible coverage.

unresolvedRanges: +0x08..+0x13 remains unresolved in this bounded header read.
qualifications: The index-buffer size consumer was not expanded in this packet.

objectLayouts.name: vertex_declaration
objectLayouts.claim: Variable vertex-declaration object allocated as 0x38+12*n after a 0xFF terminator scan; exactly n records are copied from +0x34 and a four-byte tail is not copied.

fields.name: declaration_control
qualifications: The encoded value 0x100005 is written, but no bounded consumer names its subfields.

fields.name: initialization_word
qualifications: The observed value is 1; refcount semantics are not proved for this declaration path.

fields.name: control_sentinel
qualifications: The observed value is 0xFFFF0000; no masking rule is supported.

fields.name: element_count_candidate
qualifications: n counts terminator-delimited 12-byte source steps; it is not promoted to a complete-record count without a consumer join.

fields.name: maximum_stream_candidate
qualifications: The writer stores the maximum observed stream value; API identity and reader remain unresolved.

fields.name: header_pair
qualifications: Two local stack u64 values are zeroed, bytes selected by scanned source stream indices are marked, and the locals are copied to object +0x20/+0x28; semantic names and readers remain unresolved.

fields.name: header_zero_word
qualifications: The writer stores zero; no semantic consumer is proved.

fields.name: declaration_record
qualifications: Records copy three 4-byte source words at a 12-byte stride. The terminator and allocation extent do not prove that n is a count of complete API records.

unresolvedRanges: +0x34 through the n-dependent record span has unresolved subfield meanings.
+0x34 + 12*n through +0x37 + 12*n is an un-copied four-byte allocation tail.
qualifications: The allocation expression is 0x38+12*n and the source terminator is a 16-bit 0xFF; the terminator is not copied and n is a copied-step count, not a proved complete API-record count.

fields.name: fetch_template_dword_0

fields.name: fetch_template_dword_1

fields.name: fetch_template_dword_2

fields.name: fetch_template_dword_4

objectLayouts.name: parent_backed_surface
objectLayouts.claim: 0x30-byte surface header built with a parent texture pointer at +0x18.

fields.name: surface_control
qualifications: The writer stores a common/control value; no bounded reader names its semantics.

fields.name: initialization_word
qualifications: The +0x04 word is initialized by the parent-backed creator and joins the common atomic AddRef/Release counter path; lifetime side effects make it visible.

fields.name: control_sentinel
qualifications: The observed value is 0xFFFF0000; no masking rule is supported.

fields.name: parent_texture
qualifications: The parent relationship is proved only for the parent-backed constructor; AddRef reaches the parent only when the incremented count is 1, the common word low nibble is 4, and bit 0x40000000 is set. Release has the corresponding zero-count and type/flag guards; the standalone builder does not share this field meaning.

fields.name: packed_level_word
qualifications: Packed level/layout meaning remains unresolved and no bounded reader was found.

unresolvedRanges: +0x08..+0x13 and +0x20..+0x2F remain unresolved in this parent-backed header.
qualifications: The +0x18 parent pointer is guarded to this constructor variant.

fields.name: surface_control
qualifications: The builder stores value 4; semantic API identity remains unresolved.

fields.name: initialization_word

fields.name: control_sentinel

fields.name: packed_layout_word_at_18
qualifications: The standalone builder writes this word, but its packed layout meaning and readers remain unresolved; it is not a proved parent pointer.

fields.name: layout_word_0
qualifications: The builder writes layout data; subfields and readers remain unresolved.

fields.name: layout_word_1
qualifications: The builder writes layout/control data; meaning remains unresolved.

fields.name: layout_word_2
qualifications: The builder writes layout/control data; meaning remains unresolved.

fields.name: layout_word_3
qualifications: The builder writes layout/control data; meaning remains unresolved.

fields.name: layout_word_4
qualifications: The builder writes layout/control data; meaning remains unresolved.

unresolvedRanges: +0x08..+0x13 remains unresolved; +0x18 is a known packed write with no proved semantic name.
qualifications: The +0x18 write is guarded to the standalone builder and is not promoted to a parent pointer; output parameters at guest sites 0x8269A8F4 and 0x8269A8F8 are call outputs, not header fields.

objectLayouts.name: device_draw_state
objectLayouts.claim: Partial device state surface covering dirty emission masks, stream fetch shadows, resource bindings, register shadows, and shader or declaration pointers.

fields.name: dirty_vs_alu
qualifications: Flush reads and clears this VS ALU emission mask; writer-side exact stores are outside the final bounded set.

fields.name: dirty_ps_alu
qualifications: Flush reads and clears this PS ALU emission mask; writer-side exact stores are outside the final bounded set.

fields.name: dirty_render_groups
qualifications: The flush uses this mask for render-register emission; observed declaration and shader setters also set bits, so it is draw control.

fields.name: dirty_fetch_groups
qualifications: Stream and sampler setters OR this device-base mask; the flush reads and clears it. The sampler store at 0x8268F058 targets device +0x18, not a stage-relative sampler record; this is emission control, not ignorable bookkeeping.

fields.name: dirty_misc_groups
qualifications: The flush reads and clears this mask for the 0x2300/0x2380, UCP, bool, and loop groups; writer paths are only bounded to the accepted setter entry.

fields.name: dirty_extra_mask
qualifications: The flush intersects this value with +0x10 and passes the result to 0x826AC8C8; writer and meaning remain unresolved.

fields.name: vertex_declaration_binding
qualifications: The setter writes the device binding and the draw loader reads it; declaration object layout remains partial.

fields.name: index_buffer_binding
qualifications: The setter stores the index buffer after deferred-release handling and the draw sink loads it.

fields.name: render_target_bindings
qualifications: The ring emitter compares five consecutive surface bindings; the exact writer body is outside this packet.

fields.name: stream_bindings
qualifications: The setter writes one stream slot per call; direct consumers remain unresolved.

fields.name: stream_stride_bytes
qualifications: One stride byte per stream is written; the complete stride representation and consumer remain unresolved.

fields.name: texture_bindings
qualifications: The setter and getter prove a 4-byte binding word per texture stage; draw consumption remains unresolved.

fields.name: pixel_shader_binding
qualifications: Function-entry anchor 0x82692948 identifies the producer path, but no exact field store site is claimed in this bounded evidence; readers and field semantics remain as recorded.

fields.name: vertex_shader_binding
qualifications: Function-entry anchor 0x82692C48 identifies the producer path, but no exact field store site is claimed in this bounded evidence; readers and field semantics remain as recorded.

fields.name: fetch_shadow_group
qualifications: Only shadow words +0x0C and +0x10 have a bounded getter; other four words and draw consumers remain unresolved.

fields.name: sampler_table_slot
qualifications: Static table maps sampler types through +0x1D4, but no direct writer or reader was in the bounded set.

fields.name: stream_fetch_shadow_0
qualifications: The stream setter writes this dynamic fetch-shadow word when an incoming vertex buffer is nonnull; direct consumers remain unresolved.

fields.name: stream_fetch_shadow_1
qualifications: The stream setter writes this dynamic fetch-shadow word when an incoming vertex buffer is nonnull; direct consumers remain unresolved.

unresolvedRanges: +0x309C..+0x30A8 are covered by the render_target_bindings group; stream slots after the first, texture stages after the first, and sampler types are index-dependent.
Other device bytes and all metadata ranges beyond +0x319C remain unresolved.
qualifications: The size is partial; it is a field surface, not a complete device layout.

objectLayouts.name: sampler_shadow
objectLayouts.claim: Partial stage sampler shadow record with two observed words; its setter also updates a device-base dirty mask.

fields.name: sampler_word_0
qualifications: The getter returns selected bits from this word; public sampler API identity remains unresolved.

fields.name: sampler_word_1
qualifications: The getter returns selected bits from this word; public sampler API identity remains unresolved.

unresolvedRanges: +0x00..+0x08 and any record extent beyond the two observed words remain unresolved; device +0x18 is classified separately.
qualifications: The +0x0C/+0x10 words are stage-relative shadow fields. The setter store at 0x8268F058 targets device +0x18, and does not establish a stage +0x18 field.

objectLayouts.name: draw_command_header
objectLayouts.claim: Partial device command-state view covering the cursor, limit, and five-word commit area.

fields.name: command_cursor
qualifications: The device-base cursor is read by flush and written by both the flush path and wrapper commit; ordering and lifetime semantics remain unresolved.

fields.name: command_limit
qualifications: The limit is read by the flush; its producer is outside the bounded set.

fields.name: commit_words
qualifications: These words carry the flush-to-wrapper commit edge; no word-level semantic names or safe masking rule are proved.

unresolvedRanges: The packet words written through the cursor at 0x826A333C..0x826A350C are command payload, not a complete header layout.
qualifications: The cursor, limit and commit words use the device base in the bounded bodies; no separate per-draw header allocation is established.

lifetimeFields.name: resource_type_word
qualifications: Type tests drive the common AddRef/Release lifetime path; both selected bodies load +0x00, and no complete type enum is proved.

lifetimeFields.name: resource_refcount
qualifications: The creator initializes the same +0x04 word atomically incremented and decremented by AddRef/Release; refcount and destruction side effects make this bookkeeping visible.

lifetimeFields.name: resource_fence_word
qualifications: The load at 0x8269C154 reads +0x08; 0x8269C16C is a later tail branch in the same helper, not another +0x08 field read. The stream and index setters conditionally write the prior resource +0x08 only when the prior binding and device +0x2A9C are nonzero; fence identity, generation, completion and object join remain unresolved.

lifetimeFields.name: parent_resource_pointer
qualifications: The parent pointer is written only by the parent-backed constructor. AddRef recurses only after count becomes 1 with (Common & 0xF)==4 and Common & 0x40000000 nonzero; Release recurses only after count becomes zero with the same type and flag tests.

unresolvedCoverage.reason: A conditional prior-resource +0x08 writer is proved in lifetimeFields; the exact vertex-buffer allocation join and remaining bytes are unresolved.
The index size/control reader was outside the eight-function set.
The 12-byte record stride and four-byte un-copied allocation tail extent are proved; record subfield meanings and any tail use remain unresolved.
Existing six-dword descriptor contract begins at +0x1C.
No bounded writer/reader semantics were proved.
Standalone output and packed header bytes remain unresolved; +0x18 has a known write but no semantic name and is not assumed parent-backed.
The final bounded set proves writers or selected readers only; no runtime or executable-wide absence is claimed.
Only cursor, limit, and commit words were bounded.
Conditional +0x08 writers are known for prior VB/IB bindings, but fence identity, ownership and deferred-release side effects remain unresolved.

guards: Dirty words control draw emission and remain state, even where their writer-side coverage is outside the final bounded set.
Refcount, parent and fence fields are bookkeeping candidates with lifetime side effects; no snapshot exclusion is safe from this evidence.
Declaration allocation 0x38+12*n and source 0xFF terminator prove a variable extent and 12-byte copy stride, not a proved count of complete records.
Do not infer runtime frequency, complete object layout, draw ordering, or safe capture masking from static paths.
The standalone +0x18 writer is a packed layout candidate and is not a parent pointer; the parent-backed +0x18 relationship remains constructor-specific.
The sampler setter store at 0x8268F058 targets device +0x18; no stage-relative sampler dirty field is promoted.
Refcount and fence fields have lifetime side effects, and dirty masks control emission; no snapshot exclusion is safe from this evidence.
conclusion: The bounded evidence proves byte-sized writers and readers for buffer address and size words, declaration metadata and records, texture descriptor and binding words, two distinct surface constructor families, device draw-state controls and bindings, command cursor and commit words, and resource lifetime readers. Remaining bytes and readers are listed explicitly below; these records do not authorize a complete layout or snapshot mask.
